prompts.props:
Use case: precise-object-edit / game sprite extraction and adaptation.
Asset type: transparent production-style pixel-art sprite sheet for a lighthouse defense game. Use the input sprites/background.png as the authoritative visual style: SAME cold navy slate stone blocks, same dark moss vegetation, same angular pixel clusters, same small warm amber windows. Transform its environmental motifs into isolated sprite assets for a high 3/4-from-above game camera; do NOT create a whole gameplay scene.
Create a strictly arranged 3-column by 2-row sprite sheet, landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, equal square cells, NO visible grid lines, NO text or labels. Actual transparent alpha background, no checker pattern.
Top LEFT cell: the familiar old stone signal lighthouse, modest early-stage structure, octagonal/tapered slate masonry, small dark pitched lantern roof and warm amber glazed lantern, very small arched door, sparse worn stone base. View from a noticeably higher game camera than the input, so roof and top surfaces are visible. Keep it compact and broad enough for gameplay, about twice as tall as wide. No cross, flags or added religious emblem. Preserve the input's cold stone/amber contrast. Draw complete object with its stone footing; NO large cliff island or landscape, no attached pathways, no combat beam and no surrounding glow.
Top MIDDLE: one low group of dark slate coastal rocks with readable pixel-edged faces, compact footprint, no water baked in, high 3/4 view.
Top RIGHT: one small ruined stone arch based on the input ruin, broken masonry, muted moss on top, high 3/4 view, isolated and complete.
Bottom LEFT: one small sparse clump of desaturated coastal grass, a few wind-bent blades, no ground square.
Bottom MIDDLE: a small long thin strip of ocean surf foam with a gently curved broken silhouette, cold muted blue-gray with tiny pale tips; no rectangular water patch. Suitable for scattering along a shoreline.
Bottom RIGHT: one low pile of worn rubble and pebbles based on the input stone, high 3/4 view, isolated.
Every object must fit fully inside its own equal cell with generous transparent gutters of at least 10% of cell width, no silhouettes crossing between cells, no contact sheets of alternative designs, no duplicated lighthouse. All six pieces share consistent lighting upper left, pixel density and limited palette.
Crisp genuine pixel-art clusters, no antialiasing, no brushy oil textures, no smooth vector rendering, no big cinematic shadows, no white halos, no text. These sprites will be downscaled with nearest-neighbor to lighthouse 96x144, props 32-64px; prioritize coherent silhouettes and readable broad values.
prompts.ground:
Use case: precise-object-edit / texture derivation.
Asset type: seamless repeatable square ground texture for a top-down / high oblique pixel-art lighthouse defense game.
Derive ONLY a flat ground material from the input reference's muted dark moss, weathered slate and sparse coarse soil, matching its exact cold night palette and angular pixel clusters. Fill the entire SQUARE canvas edge to edge with this low-contrast terrain texture. Dark desaturated blue-green moss over compact soil with very sparse tiny slate chips, quiet mottled variation. The purpose is empty playable ground on which units and device sprites remain easy to see. No large stones, plants, towers, coastline, ocean, paths, walls, scene perspective or horizon. No border and no text. No bright or saturated green. Illumination is even and diffuse, no directional overall gradient, no vignette and no object shadows.
Make all four edges tile seamlessly. Genuine carefully clustered pixel art rather than smooth noise, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no visible grids or outlined square tiles. Target eventual native tile128x128; retain broad subtle material variation rather than dense noisy micro-detail. Opaque background.
prompts.water:
Use case: precise-object-edit / texture derivation.
Asset type: seamless repeatable square ocean texture for a top-down / high oblique pixel-art lighthouse defense game.
Derive ONLY the ocean material from input reference's very dark navy sea, sparse horizontal blue ripples and restrained desaturated slate-blue wave crests. Match its pixel scale and cold palette. Fill entire SQUARE canvas edge to edge with quiet open-water texture, high top-down game view. Water must remain readable beneath future aquatic devices and creatures. Scattered broken horizontal 2-4px wave clusters, mostly dark blue water. No coastline, islands, rocks, lighthouse, ship, reflections of moon/lantern, horizon, foam wall, borders, text or gradients. No brilliant white or cyan, no smooth photoreal rendering.
Make all four edges tile seamlessly with low-contrast repetition. Genuine pixel art, crisp clusters and no anti-aliasing or blur. Target eventual native tile128x128. Opaque background.
